The key fact about "Monopoly 200X" is how its seven prize levels are built. The prize money leans toward small, frequent prizes. Games built like this pay out often, in small amounts. Prize counts change daily, but this design does not.

827.body:
"50th Anniversary" is down to one top prize after a $15 million winner was claimed last week. The game started with three top prizes. Know that before you buy, because a change in top prizes changes the whole game.

The most common prize left on "50th Anniversary" right now is $100.

If "50th Anniversary" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
827.headline: Someone claimed a $15 million prize
